title: Voice of Customer Examples: What Good Output Looks Like
summary: Voice of customer examples that show the evidence behind the score. Copy a filled VOC table, report structure, and interview sequence.
body_markdown:
What is voice of the customer? +


Voice of the customer (VOC) is the structured collection of customer language, behavior, and context used to inform a specific decision.


What are good voice of customer examples? +


Good voice of customer examples tie each theme to a verbatim, participant ID, timestamp, and recording. Customer satisfaction score dashboards alone fall short.


What does a voice of customer report example include? +


A voice of customer report example lists each theme with its verbatim, evidence, and decision implication, turning customer data into actionable insights. Stakeholders can open the recording behind any finding.


Is there a reusable voice of customer template? +


Yes. Use four fixed columns: verbatim, theme, evidence, and decision implication. Identical columns keep themes comparable across studies.


Why do VOC findings get challenged in reviews? +


Findings without sources read as interpretation. Stakeholders dismiss themes they cannot trace to a customer, however strong the customer sentiment data looks.


How do you keep VOC comparable over time? +


Fix question wording, order, and taxonomy so voice of customer examples stay comparable. One changed phrase breaks theme tracking.
